visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young person with short black hair is seen extremely close-up through a fisheye lens, creating a distorted and humorous facial appearance. They are wearing a bright yellow button-down shirt with a red 'Lipton' brand logo on the chest. The person is in a well-lit corridor with white tiled walls and a polished floor, making exaggerated expressions towards the camera. (2) The scene cuts to the same person standing in an elevator, continuing to make funny faces at the lens. They then exit the elevator into a modern office lobby featuring a large red wall with international city names in white text. The person gestures towards the wall and walks energetically forward into the workspace. (3) The individual enters a large, open-plan office filled with rows of desks, computer monitors, and chairs. They are carrying a large white insulated delivery bag with the Lipton brand logo prominently displayed. Several office workers are visible in the background, mostly focused on their computer screens and appearing to ignore the creator. (4) The creator interacts with a male employee sitting in a gray bean bag chair at his desk. They hold a white tablet showing a grid of similar-looking faces and a bottle of Lipton milk tea. The employee wears glasses and a dark jacket, laughing as he talks with the creator and eventually drinks the beverage. (5) The creator moves to interact with a female employee with long black hair, showing her the same photo grid. She laughs and covers her mouth in amusement. Later, the creator is seen with another male employee in a white jacket, engaging in a loud, expressive interaction with high-energy physical gestures after the employee drinks the milk tea. (6) A montage shows the creator handing out bottles of the yellow-labeled milk tea to various people around the office. People are seen laughing, taking photos with their smartphones, and gesturing in excitement. The creator eventually holds a golden gong and a mallet, striking it while standing next to a seated employee, surrounded by onlookers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic male voice speaks rapidly with exaggerated intonations and a humorous delivery. The background features bright, bouncy electronic music with a steady rhythmic pulse and playful synthesizer melodies. Faint room tone and the shuffling of clothes are audible under the vocals. (2) A sharp digital 'beep' chime marks a transition, followed by the soft metallic ring of an elevator arrival bell. The main speaker continues narration with high arousal and rapid speech. A quick 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes a visual jump cut as the music continues to drive the energy. (3) The acoustic environment shifts slightly with increased reverb as the speaker enters a larger open office space. Distant, low-level keyboard typing and background murmurs are faintly heard. The primary voice maintains dominance with a high pitch contour and friendly, comedic tone. (4) Interaction with a secondary male voice occurs, which is lower in pitch and more conversational. The music volume ducks slightly to prioritize the dialogue. A soft 'pop' sound effect is heard when a bottle is opened, followed by the sound of liquid swallowing and a collaborative laugh. (5) Multiple voices of different timbres are heard as the creator interacts with more people. A female voice laughs brightly. Frequent cartoon-style sound effects like dings and whistles punctuate the interactions. The music swells in excitement as more people join the vocal mix. (6) The audio reaches a peak density with several people cheering and talking simultaneously. A loud, resonant gong strike creates a massive percussive transient with a long, shimmering metallic sustain. This is followed by a series of fast-paced vocal outbursts and a final energetic statement from the creator before the audio fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Interaction -> Endorsement -> Climax -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comedic promotional piece for Lipton milk tea, featuring popular creator HOOK visiting an office in brand-colored attire. Through a series of humorous challenges and interactions, the creator delivers the product to employees, associating the brand with relief from workplace tiredness ('healing/upgrading').

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator wears brand-specific clothing, carries a branded bag, and specifically promotes the Lipton milk tea product with a slogan.
